hard_anchors: Short-term deterministic structure is ascending, coherent, and marked by a confirmed bullish break of structure.

The current trading range is wide and short-horizon ATR materially exceeds medium-horizon ATR, indicating expanding realized volatility.
Participation has remained above the trailing volume average for each of the latest three sessions, supporting volume expansion.
Price is near the short-term resistance area while also above nearby support, so continuation structure has not yet resolved into a confirmed breakout status.
Long-term deterministic structure remains transition, creating a higher-timeframe qualification on the short-term advance.
